feature_families.family: Indexing, readers, commits, deletes, merges, NRT
feature_families.gap: Native index lifecycle exists; Lucene update-doc-values, commit/snapshot, NRT, concurrency and failure contracts are not exhaustively mapped or tested.

feature_families.family: Term, Boolean, exclusions, minimum SHOULD match
feature_families.gap: Native term/Boolean APIs exist. FILTER is expressible through zero-score ConstScoreQuery but lacks an occurrence variant. Do not infer all clause rewrite/scoring contracts from tested benchmark queries.

feature_families.family: Exact/sloppy phrases, repeated terms, multiphrases and proximity
feature_families.gap: Exact/sloppy phrase surface exists. Sloppy distance-weighted frequency, repeated-term occurrence collision handling, carrying slop width and full MultiPhrase behavior require differential proof.

feature_families.family: BM25 parameters, field population, norms, score scale and bounds
feature_families.gap: Native k1/b fixed at 1.2/0.75; raw multiplier is k1+1 (2.2). Field population differs, deleted-merge token totals are approximated, overlap/DOCS-only norm semantics differ. Matched benchmark overrides do not establish native parity.

feature_families.family: Classic TF-IDF, LM, DFR/IB/DFI and pluggable Similarity
feature_families.gap: Custom Rust Query/Scorer extensions are possible; built-in Lucene Similarity model families and their public/protected subclass hooks are absent.

feature_families.family: Automaton, regexp, fuzzy, prefix, wildcard, term sets and rewrites
feature_families.gap: Several native query families exist; full Lucene automaton/rewrite methods, rewrite limits, Unicode and fuzzy edit contracts remain untested.

feature_families.family: Span queries and positional/payload spans
feature_families.gap: No built-in SpanQuery/Spans family. PhraseQuery is not a replacement for composable span-near, span-not, span-first and payload spans.

feature_families.family: Intervals, sources and interval functions
feature_families.gap: No built-in Lucene interval-source algebra or interval query family; aggregation time intervals are unrelated.

feature_families.family: Float/byte KNN vectors, vector similarities and filtered search
feature_families.gap: No built-in vector field or KNN query/search family. Custom field plugins are an extension mechanism, not an implemented equivalent.

feature_families.family: HNSW graphs, vector codecs, quantization and graph extension APIs
feature_families.gap: No built-in HNSW indexing/graph navigation, vector format, scalar/binary quantization or backward vector codec parity.

feature_families.family: BKD, multidimensional points, dimensional ranges and geometry indexing
feature_families.gap: Scalar range matching exists via term/fast-field paths; no native BKD point tree or Lucene multidimensional PointValues/shape indexing.

feature_families.family: LatLon/XY shapes, spatial strategies and 3D geometry
feature_families.gap: No built-in geospatial fields, geometry relations, SpatialStrategy or spatial3d topology APIs.

feature_families.family: Numeric/date/IP range and exists queries
feature_families.gap: Scalar ranges/exists exist; missing-value, multivalue, inclusivity, NaN, date resolution and Lucene field-type contracts are not exhaustively tested.

feature_families.family: Doc values, sorted fields, multivalues and updates
feature_families.gap: Typed columnar fast fields and sorting exist; full Lucene doc-values update, iterator, ordinal and caching APIs are not native equivalents.

feature_families.family: Stored fields, visitors, documents and term vectors
feature_families.gap: Stored documents and term postings exist; Lucene per-document term-vector/payload/offset and StoredFieldVisitor contracts need explicit mapping, not postings-name equivalence.

feature_families.family: Top scores, count, sort, pagination, collector managers and caches
feature_families.gap: Native count/top/sort exist. Total-hits thresholds, searchAfter, ties, slice concurrency, query caching and collector callback contracts remain incomplete.

feature_families.family: Block joins, parent/child, query-time joins and vector joins
feature_families.gap: No built-in Lucene ToParent/ToChildBlockJoin, JoinUtil or block-join vector-query family.

feature_families.family: Grouped TopDocs, collapse and two-pass grouping
feature_families.gap: Aggregation buckets are available; grouped top-document selection, group selectors, first/second-pass contracts and Lucene grouping API are not implemented equivalents.

feature_families.family: Taxonomy, sorted-set, range, hierarchical and association facets
feature_families.gap: Hierarchical facet counting and aggregation exist; taxonomy readers/writers, drill-sideways, associations and full Lucene facet lifecycle differ or are absent.

feature_families.family: Classic, vector and unified highlighters, passages and offsets
feature_families.gap: SnippetGenerator exists. Phrase/offset-aware unified highlighting, term vectors, passage scoring, break iterators and all protected formatter hooks need separate implementation/testing.

feature_families.family: Token streams, attributes, filters and general/language analyzers
feature_families.gap: Token/filter/analyzer extensions, stemming and common filters exist; Lucene's complete analyzer catalog, char filters, attributes, token graph, position/offset and lifecycle contracts are not equivalent.

feature_families.family: ICU analysis, collation, normalization and segmentation
feature_families.gap: ASCII folding is not ICU normalization, segmentation or collation. No built-in ICU analyzer suite.

feature_families.family: Japanese morphological analysis and dictionaries
feature_families.gap: No built-in Kuromoji-equivalent morphological analyzer/dictionary API.

feature_families.family: Morfologik dictionary stemming
feature_families.gap: Generic stemmer support does not provide Morfologik dictionary behavior/API.

feature_families.family: Korean morphological analysis and dictionaries
feature_families.gap: No built-in Nori-equivalent morphological analyzer/dictionary API.

feature_families.family: OpenNLP sentence/token/POS/chunk/lemma analysis
feature_families.gap: No built-in OpenNLP model-loading and token-attribute analyzer suite.

feature_families.family: Phonetic token filters and algorithms
feature_families.gap: No built-in Lucene phonetic encoder/filter suite.

feature_families.family: Chinese dictionary segmentation
feature_families.gap: No built-in SmartChinese analyzer/dictionary behavior/API.

feature_families.family: Stempel Polish stemming
feature_families.gap: No built-in Stempel table-driven Polish stemmer API; generic Language enum is not equivalent.

feature_families.family: Classic, flexible, simple, complex-phrase, surround and XML parsers
feature_families.gap: A native parser exists, but full Lucene grammar/modes, XML builders, extension subclasses and rewrite rules are not covered. Pure-negative strict parsing differs.

feature_families.family: Expression compilation, bindings and expression sorting/scoring
feature_families.gap: Optional Rust JIT expressions/predicates exist; Lucene JavaScript compiler, Bindings, function registry, value-source and bytecode extension contracts differ.

feature_families.family: Function queries, value sources, custom scores and MoreLikeThis
feature_families.gap: MoreLikeThis/custom scoring/predicates exist; full Lucene ValueSource/DoubleValuesSource algebra and Java subclass contracts are missing.

feature_families.family: Autocomplete, FST suggesters, spellchecking and lookup
feature_families.gap: FST dictionaries and fuzzy queries are primitives, not Lucene suggesters, weighted/contextual completion, spellcheck or lookup behavior.

feature_families.family: Bayes/KNN/perceptron document classification
feature_families.gap: Search primitives are present; no built-in Lucene classification algorithms or classifier contracts.

feature_families.family: Reverse search, stored query monitoring and presearchers
feature_families.gap: No built-in Monitor query persistence, candidate presearching, matcher and update lifecycle.

feature_families.family: Index replication, revision/session lifecycle and copy recovery
feature_families.gap: Directory APIs permit application-level copying; no built-in Lucene revision/session/replication client-handler protocol or recovery semantics.

feature_families.family: Single-document MemoryIndex
feature_families.gap: In-memory indexes exist; that does not establish MemoryIndex reset/freeze/offset/term-vector/scoring API semantics or comparable lifecycle cost.

feature_families.family: Postings, terms, doc values, stored fields, codec SPI and backward formats
feature_families.gap: Native Rust codecs/backward Tantivy formats exist; Lucene codecs/SPI/legacy Lucene formats are not supported. 128-doc vs 256-doc blocks and flat vs hierarchical skip execution differ.

feature_families.family: Directory, locks, FS/mmap/RAM I/O and failure contracts
feature_families.gap: Corresponding native storage primitives exist; Lucene file lifecycle/locking/crash consistency and Java public/protected extension contracts remain untested.

feature_families.family: Index maintenance, integrity checks, rearranging and miscellaneous utilities
feature_families.gap: Some indexing/merge operations exist; complete Lucene misc tools, CheckIndex-style reports and CLI behaviors are not native equivalents.

feature_families.family: Experimental queries, facets, sorting, tracing and utilities
feature_families.gap: Module fully inventoried at type/member level. Individual experimental behavior contracts need explicit review; no family-level parity claim.

feature_families.family: Benchmark tasks, feeds, parsers and quality evaluation
feature_families.gap: A project-specific comparison harness exists, not Lucene benchmark task-language/feed/quality APIs. Matched scoring overrides must remain disclosed.

feature_families.family: IndexFiles/SearchFiles demos and CLI examples
feature_families.gap: Rust examples/adapters exist; Java demo classes, command-line flags, output and file compatibility are not provided.

feature_families.family: Randomized, codec, analyzer, directory and fault-injection test framework
feature_families.gap: Rust tests/proptest exist; Lucene's reusable Java randomized base classes, mock wrappers, assertions and subclass hooks are not equivalents.

feature_families.family: Luke Swing GUI, index inspection and tools
feature_families.gap: Reader primitives do not constitute the Luke GUI, tool workflows or Java model/presenter APIs.

feature_families.family: Java public/protected extensibility, subclassing and SPI
feature_families.gap: Rust traits/plugins support native extensions; no Java facade/JNI class hierarchy, inherited protected hooks, exceptions, serialization, module exports or binary ABI compatibility.

feature_families.family: Read/write Lucene 10.4 and older index files
feature_families.gap: Native Tantivy files/meta/codec are incompatible with Lucene's segment formats. Shared algorithm names do not establish on-disk interchange.
